name: Gari Tim Simulator
description: Uleteo/la si u MKDSLend sastanak koji vec traje. Imas jedan sastanak da se snades, izaberes odgovore, steknesh affinity — i mozda, ako si dovoljno primetljiv/a, zavrsis sa zadatkom koji ti odgovara.

modules.index.html: Glavni HTML entry point, PWA meta, module script tag
modules.src/main.js: State machine — scene runner, init, game loop
modules.src/config.js: Konstante, character colors, typing speed, scene order
modules.src/input.js: setupInput() — click/touch handlers za opcije dugmadi
modules.src/audio.js: AudioManager: init, playAmbient, playClick, playDing, setScene
modules.src/ui.js: renderScene(), renderNarration(), renderDialogue(), renderChoices(), renderShareCard(), showEnding()
modules.src/render.js: typing effect (char-by-char), fade transitions, character name display
modules.src/systems/scenes.js: loadScene(n, state) → returns first node ID for scene
modules.src/content/characters.js: CHARACTERS objekt: gari, mici, brana, tonket, dule, pera sa name, color, role
modules.src/content/dialogue_tree.js: DIALOGUE_NODES: svi node-ovi za sve scene (Scene 0-8 kompletno)
modules.src/content/endings_content.js: ENDINGS: {1..6} sa title, narration, shareText, characterColor
modules.src/content/share_texts.js: SHARE_TEXTS per ending za Web Share API
modules.src/content/aforizmi.js: AFORIZMI: flavor citati, min 3 per character
modules.styles/ui.css: dialogue box, choice buttons, share card
modules.styles/game.css: typing animation, fade transitions, scene enter animations
modules.styles/theme.css: CSS custom properties — paleta po liku
